mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.*,COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=ms.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE r.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} ORDER BY r.ingredient_id,r.menu_id

SELECT s.meal_service_id,s.table_id,DATE_FORMAT(s.meal_date,'%Y-%m-%d') meal_date,s.meal_slot,s.status,s.planned_servings,s.actual_servings, CASE WHEN s.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELED') AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage u JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service o ON o.meal_service_id=u.meal_service_id WHERE o.account_id=s.account_id AND o.table_id=s.table_id AND o.meal_date=s.meal_date AND o.meal_slot=s.meal_slot AND u.reversed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END needs_reconfirm FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=s.table_id AND t.account_id=s.account_id WHERE s.account_id=#{account_id} AND s.table_id=#{table_id} AND t.status<>'CANCELED' ORDER BY s.meal_date,COALESCE((SELECT sm0.display_order FROM the_full_order.tb_meal_slot_master sm0 WHERE sm0.meal_slot_code=s.meal_slot_code),s.meal_slot_code),s.meal_service_id

SELECT po.purchase_order_id,s.supplier_name,DATE_FORMAT(po.requested_delivery_date,'%Y-%m-%d') delivery_date,po.status FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=po.supplier_id WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.status IN ('ORDERED','CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_RECEIVED','NOT_RECEIVED') AND po.requested_delivery_date<=#{date_to} ORDER BY po.requested_delivery_date,po.purchase_order_id LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance SET average_unit_cost=CASE WHEN current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}=0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(inventory_amount+#{amount_delta},0)/(current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}) END, inventory_amount=CASE WHEN current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}=0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(inventory_amount+#{amount_delta},0) END, current_base_qty=current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta},last_movement_at=NOW(),user_id=#{user_id} WHERE inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} AND current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}>=0

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot SET remaining_base_qty=remaining_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}, status=CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','CONSUMED') THEN status WHEN remaining_base_qty=0 THEN 'CONSUMED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END WHERE inventory_lot_id=#{inventory_lot_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} AND remaining_base_qty+#{quantity_delta} BETWEEN 0 AND received_base_qty
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND reversed_at IS NULL ORDER BY inventory_balance_id,usage_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage SET reversed_at=NOW() WHERE usage_id=#{usage_id} AND reversed_at IS NULL

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=ms.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=ms.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) SET r.product_name_snapshot=COALESCE(lot.product_name_snapshot,ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw), r.origin_name_snapshot=COALESCE(NULLIF(lot.origin_name_snapshot,''),'원산지 미확인') WHERE r.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND r.origin_name_snapshot IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id,COALESCE(r.product_name_snapshot,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(r.origin_name_snapshot,'원산지 미확인 (보존 기록 없음)') origin_name,'SAVED' origin_source,ms.meal_service_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} AND ms.status<>'COMPLETED' UNION ALL SELECT u.menu_id,u.ingredient_id,u.product_name_snapshot,u.origin_name_snapshot,'ACTUAL',ms.meal_service_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage u JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=u.meal_service_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} AND u.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.status='COMPLETED'
